write_fact: [the, code, for, ENT_t, is, VAL_t, .] — presents the explicit fact ENT_t -> VAL_t
query: [the, code, for, ENT_t, is] -> predict VAL_t

legitimate_lookup_key.reason: ENT_t appears in the query context the system observes at query time; it is extracted from the query tokens, not from any label/oracle.

stored_value_is_observed_not_oracle: the value VAL_t is written to the table at WRITE time from the explicit fact the system observed (ENT_t is VAL_t) — the same information written to slots. It is NOT a hidden answer label, correct slot index, or evaluator ground truth.
forbidden_signals_not_used: needle identity not present in the query
oracle information available only to the test harness
no_benchmark_redesign: the benchmark is used unchanged; the lookup key is a pre-existing legitimate property of the needle query (the entity id in the query).
key_extraction_rule: at write time key = (session_id, tenant_id, entity_id=ENT_t, version); at query time the entity id is parsed from the query span 'the code for <ENT> is' — the token following 'for' before 'is'.
